svg.title: Analysis Explainer workflow
svg.desc: Locate evidence — Check tables and renders — Evidence locations; Explain method — Unit, bio_n, parameters — Method notes; Separate claims — Observation, inference, interpretation, hypothesis — Bounded claims; Deliver Figure Summary — Bind values to version — Figure Summary
